description:
From stories shaped across generations, to diamonds formed beneath the Kalahari Desert, this region is defined by what endures. Through the Okavango Eternal partnership between De Beers and National Geographic, Storytelling Clubs are equipping young people with creative tools and photography skills, empowering them to preserve the stories of the Okavango Delta in their own voices.
